_comment: Polaris' own UEFI drivers, as published by Project-Silicium/Device-Binaries under polaris/.
Unlike raphael's file (which records hand-made patches to binaries extracted from the
phone's own xbl.img), polaris needs no patch tool: Device-Binaries already ships the
patched modules as <module>.patched.efi, and the .inf files in that repository already
select them. Nothing here is applied by any script in this repository; it is a description
of what the upstream submodule contains, kept so the port can be re-audited.

binaries.note: Not committed here and MUST NOT be fabricated. A build without it fails; that is the honest state.

patched_modules.reason: Make the Power button usable in UEFI instead of the Qualcomm key code.
Drop the USB deinit from ExitBootServices so the OS keeps the port.
polaris-specific: keep the IOMMU out of the way for the display path; not in raphael's set.

not_patched.reason: raphael patches this for UFS cache coherence. polaris' Device-Binaries copy is unpatched and there is no polaris measurement showing it is needed. TODO(polaris): decide after a boot.
redwood patches the global TZ applet variable. polaris' copy is unpatched; TODO(polaris): check whether polaris' TZ applet needs the same variable before trusting it.
redwood marks the disk non-removable. polaris' copy is unpatched; TODO(polaris): decide whether polaris' UsbMsdDxe needs it.

gaps: No panel XML and no DisplayDxe tuning data exist under polaris/RawFiles (the directory holds only .cfg, .bmp and BATTERY.PROVISION files). That is why USE_CUSTOM_DISPLAY_DRIVER is 0 here.
polaris/QcomPkg/XBLCore/XBLCore.{inf,raw,te} exists; the UEFI FD is built by Mu, not taken from there.
